<thought>The search for templates that break a C–Cl bond and form a C–C bond returned no results. To find a suitable Friedel‑Crafts acylation template, I will instead search by functional groups: the forward reaction breaks a halide (e.g., C–Cl) and forms a carbonyl (ketone) group. This should locate the appropriate retrosynthetic template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1ccc(CNc2c(C(=O)Nc3cccc(OC)c3)nnn2Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketone"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
